第 51 章 Manage Complexity with Diversity用多样性管理复杂性

Mike Fisher / 迈克·费舍尔

— 第 149 页 —

As engineering managers, we often develop and manage complex systems that have interacting components (people, process, technology), the combination of which make it very difficult to predict the outcome from simply observing the inputs. Additionally, many of the subsystems are tightly coupled in that a failure of one can result in cascading failures. As such, managing the inherent risk associated with these complex systems is a daunting task.

作为工程经理，我们经常开发和管理有交互组件（人、流程、技术）的复杂系统，它们的组合使得仅通过观察输入就预测结果非常困难。此外，许多子系统紧耦合，一个失败可能导致级联失败。因此，管理这些复杂系统固有的风险是一项艰巨任务。

Decades of research into the management of complex systems has given us normal accident theory, high reliability, and the logic of failure, just to name a few. Organizational design based on high reliability even identifies five characteristics of organizations that are best to deal with complexity: preoccupation with failure, reluctance to simplify interpretations, sensitivity to unexpected conditions, commitment to resilience, and deference to experts. The logic of failure identifies ways to fail in the decision-making process, including failing to prioritize goals, using overly reductive models, and failing to generate alternative plans. However, only recently have researchers turned their focus to the makeup of the organization instead of its behavioral characteristics and processes.

几十年对复杂系统管理的研究给我们提供了正常事故理论、高可靠性、失败的逻辑，仅举几例。基于高可靠性的组织设计甚至识别了最能应对复杂性的组织的五个特征：对失败的专注、不愿简化解释、对意外条件的敏感、对韧性的承诺、对专家的尊重。失败的逻辑识别了决策过程中失败的方式，包括未能优先排序目标、使用过度简化的模型、未能生成备选计划。然而直到最近研究人员才把焦点转向组织的构成而不是行为特征和流程。

Research has begun to catch up with what savvy practitioners have long known, that diverse teams are better able to manage complex systems. "Groupthink" is a very real phenomenon that plagues teams that are composed of a cohesive group of individuals who share many similar characteristics. Our willingness to disagree in a group increases dramatically if the group is diverse. Homogeneity might facilitate smooth and effortless interactions, but diversity drives better decisions. Interestingly, it's the diversity and not necessarily the specific contributions of the individuals themselves that causes greater skepticism, more open and active dialogue, and less groupthink.

研究开始追上精明从业者早就知道的事：多样化的团队更能管理复杂系统。「群体思维」是一个非常真实的现象，困扰由一群有凝聚力、有很多相似特征的个人组成的团队。如果群体多样化，我们在群体中表达不同意见的意愿会显著增加。同质性可能促进顺畅不费力的互动，但多样性驱动更好的决策。有趣的是，是多样性而不一定是个人的具体贡献导致更多怀疑、更开放和活跃的对话、更少的群体思维。

— 第 150 页 —

Healthy skepticism is incredibly useful in myriad situations. One such situation is during premortems, in which a project team imagines that a project has failed and works to identify what potentially could lead to such an outcome. This is very different from a postmortem, in which the failure has already occurred and the team is dissecting the failure. Often, individuals who have been working on projects for weeks or more are biased with overconfidence that the project will be successful. The premortem exercise can help ameliorate these biases, especially when diverse team members participate.

健康的怀疑在无数场景中极其有用。一种是事前验尸，项目团队想象项目已经失败，努力识别什么可能导致这种结果。这和事后验尸非常不同——后者失败已经发生，团队在剖析失败。通常，在项目上工作了几周或更久的人会有项目会成功的过度自信偏见。事前验尸练习可以帮助改善这些偏见，尤其是多样化团队成员参与时。

Another benefit of having a diverse team is the culture of inclusivity that it helps to develop. Even though recruiting or large compensation packages might bring in diverse candidates, those candidates will stay only if the culture is inclusive enough to value them and their contributions. Having an inclusive culture trains engineers and managers to listen to one another and drop the preconceived notions about someone's knowledge or ideas. During a crisis or incident, having a team whose culture is open and inclusive allows them to accept ideas from many viewpoints. This results in more creative problem solving and faster resolution of issues.

拥有多样化团队的另一个好处是它帮助发展的包容文化。即使招聘或高薪包可能带来多样化候选人，这些候选人只有在文化足够包容、重视他们和他们的贡献时才会留下。包容的文化训练工程师和经理互相倾听、放下对某人知识或想法的先入之见。在危机或事件期间，拥有文化开放包容的团队让他们接受来自多观点的想法。这带来更有创意的问题解决和更快的问题解决。

Managing complex systems can be a daunting task for any engineering manager, but there are strategies that many of us have relied on to help. One of the most effective that I've found is surrounding yourself with a great team of people, and that means a diverse team. When our teams comprise diverse members, we make better decisions, build better products, and manage complex systems better.

管理复杂系统对任何工程经理都可能是艰巨任务，但我们很多人依赖一些策略来帮忙。我发现最有效的之一是身边有一个很棒的团队，那意味着多样化的团队。当我们的团队有多样化成员时，我们做更好的决策、建更好的产品、更好地管理复杂系统。
